title: Normalized internal-to-sectionwise derived tensor comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site $J$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] in the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], $B=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], with the sheaf tensor [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor], and $B_{sec}$ its section-ring sheaf. Write $\mathcal A$ for internal $B$-module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], $\mathcal M$ for sectionwise module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $F$ for the canonical section-action equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Use its termwise extension $D(F)$ to ordinary unbounded derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], the relative tensor [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor] and its K-flat derived tensor [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Let $H$ be the functorial K-injective ringed-site derived Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and let $S,T$ be its ordinary closed tensor structure and K-flat/K-injective representative models [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. A normalized internal-to-sectionwise derived tensor comparison for $S,T$ is a natural isomorphism $t:D(F)(K\otimes^L_B L)\cong S(D(F)K,D(F)L)$ whose value on every pair of K-flat representatives is the localization of the canonical total-complex comparison of [lem-pe-internal-section-tensor-comparison]: the square from the native lax localization map, the termwise factorization of $D(F)$ and the specified tensor-model isomorphism commutes. The total-complex comparison is the fixed map on local pure tensors and total summands, transported across the two concrete implementations of the same total complexes. K-flatness of representatives can equivalently be tested after $F$. The concrete total comparison and termwise localization factors are those of [def-sfb-internal-section-total-comparison]. The representative localization square is also expressed generically for two source categories, two target categories, their localization functors, termwise and localized comparison functors, the factorization isomorphism, both tensor bifunctors, the lax source localization map, the ordinary total comparison and the target model comparison: it requires equality of the two composites from the localized source tensor to the tensor of localized target representatives, for every pair satisfying the model predicate. Its specialization is the normalization just specified.
